summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the date for its Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine earnings notice with no special-situation catalyst or event. The role is issuer providing a standard update to shareholders.
